known.name: Lightning Rod and Storm Drain take the move in
known.reason: From generation 5 Lightning Rod and Storm Drain make their holder immune to the type they draw and raise its Sp. Atk; the engine still runs Platinum's ability, which only draws the move.

known.name: Photon Geyser's physical side
known.reason: Photon Geyser is physical when its user's Attack is higher than its Sp. Atk, and ignores abilities; the data gives it no effect, so the engine runs it as a plain special move and counts it fully run.

known.name: the screens are the last modifier
known.owner: plan 06 · the modern damage formula (a session of its own, before R24)
known.reason: Platinum halves a hit behind Reflect or Light Screen before the roll, the same-type bonus and the type chart (and takes two thirds for two behind one screen); from generation 5 a screen is a final modifier, 2048/4096 or 2732/4096 in a double battle, applied after them, and Aurora Veil with them.

known.name: the burn halves after the type chart
known.owner: plan 06 · the modern damage formula (a session of its own, before R24)
known.reason: Platinum halves a burned Pokémon's physical hit inside the base damage, before the + 2; from generation 5 the halving comes after the roll, the same-type bonus and the type chart.

known.name: the weather comes after the + 2
known.owner: plan 06 · the modern damage formula (a session of its own, before R24)
known.reason: Platinum strengthens or weakens a Fire or Water move in the sun or the rain inside the base damage, before the + 2; from generation 5 the weather is a modifier of its own after it, beside a spread hit's.

known.name: the modifiers in 4096ths
known.owner: plan 06 · the modern damage formula (a session of its own, before R24)
known.reason: Platinum rounds down after every bonus; from generation 5 the bonuses to the power, the stats and the damage are chained in 4096ths and rounded half down, the weather and a spread hit come before the critical hit, and the same-type bonus is rounded half down. Differences of a point or two.
